caption: The video captures a brightly lit carousel turning beneath an ornate gold canopy with painted panels. Several painted horses carry riders, including a woman in a pale blue dress on a white horse. A person in a striped shirt with a blue cross-body bag stands on a pink horse, holding a phone up near the overhead pole. A woman in black overalls sits on a yellow horse, and a rider in a white shirt sits on a blue winged horse. The rotation is already underway, carrying near-side horses and riders steadily from left to right. The pink and yellow horses drift out of view, while the blue winged horse moves toward the center.
